wiki.title: Amanda Nedweski
wiki.extract: Amanda Marie Nedweski (born December 22, 1975) is an American financial analyst and Republican politician from Kenosha County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 32nd Assembly district since 2025; she previously represented the 61st Assembly district during the 2023–2024 term. She also previously served as a member of the Kenosha County board of supervisors.
